ability.name: Verify Scanner Availability
ability.description: Check if nmap or other security scanners are on local path.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); nmap --version; Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true" } catch { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step2.txt

rationale: Verifies whether native or pre-installed executables exist, otherwise pivots to native PowerShell discovery implementations.
